_doc: Lilycove Department Store floors (18x8): back wall rows 0-1 with the elevator (2,1) and the stairs (13,1) / (16,1) as Sapphire's warps say (up = stair_u01 in a wall recess, down = stair_d01 in a floor opening); counters, goods shelf blocks, coolers, windows, planters and plants at Sapphire's tiles (per floor below). Orange floor (Black 2 Center tiles, as the Herb Shop). Service counter (6,2), (7-10,3), (11,2) with two registers; planters (0-1, 5) and (0-1, 7); plants (14,7), (16,7), (17,7); red stools on walkable (16,3) and (16,5) = floor cushions (Black 2 convention); exit mat (8-9, 7). Sapphire's floor-guide sign is at (0,8), outside the map: kept there.
